    ans = "Yes"

    h, w, n = map(int, input().split())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))
    a.sort(reverse=True)
    l = [[h, w]]

    for i in range(n):
        x = 2 ** a[i]
        y = 2 ** a[i]

        m = len(l)
        f = 0
        for j in range(m):
            s, t = l[j]

            if x <= s and y <= t:
                l.pop(j)
                w1 = s - x
                h1 = t

                if 0 < h1:
                    p = [x, h1]
                    p.sort()
                    l.append(p)

                w2 = s
                h2 = t - y

                if 0 < w2:
                    q = [w2, y]
                    q.sort()
                    l.append(q)

                l.sort()
                f = 1
                break

        if f == 0:
            ans = "No"
            break
